name: unauthorized-run
description: Recorded 2026-10-10 against POST https://api.bowmark.ai/v1/monid/run with an invalid API key. Bowmark answers 401 with a run-shaped envelope (status needs_user) that tells the caller how to get a key. Data, zero usage.

body.error:
The Bowmark API key this call presented is no longer valid, so nothing ran. It was not recognised — the key may have been revoked, or deleted from the account that held it.

Retrying will not help, and the key cannot be reinstated. Show your user these steps:
1. Sign in at https://bowmark.ai/sign-up and open https://bowmark.ai/dashboard/keys.
2. Check whether the key is still listed there. If it is not, it is gone.
3. Create a new key and replace the old one where Bowmark is configured:
   - MCP

meta.wwwAuthenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://api.bowmark.ai/oauth/protected-resource/mcp", error="invalid_token", error_description="A Bowmark account is required."
